turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.

Suno, main yahan hoon. Aur pehle ek baat — yeh ungrateful nahi hai. Sach mein nahi.

Jab koi actually achhi hoti hai baby ke saath, tab hi shayad sabse zyada confusing ho jaata hai. Kyunki phir dimag mein ek alarm bajta hai — "itni achhi hai, tujhe kya problem hai, tujhe toh grateful hona chahiye." Aur us alarm ki wajah se apne real feelings ko hi ignore kar deti hai tu.

Aur chaar mahine ki baby ke saath apna naam bhool jaana — yeh dramatic nahi hai, yeh sach hai. Identity wapas milti hai, lekin pehle thodi gayab hoti hai. Bahut normal hai.

Ab bata — "expert level" wali baat thodi aur khol ke bataogi? Kyunki mujhe lagta hai wahan hi kuch atak raha hai. Kya wo har cheez mein apni tarah se karti hain — feeding, sleeping, soothing? Kya tujhe lagta hai tera koi bhi decision challenge hota hai kyunki "main ne toh teen paale hain"? Ya kuch aur chal raha hai?

Tu bol, main sun rahi hoon.

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

Ruk.

Jo tune abhi bola — woh "room service" wala line — usko seriously le. Kyunki wahan kuch important hai.

Jab baby chup ho jaati hai Aai ke haath mein — aur sab muskurate hain — toh message yeh hota hai: "tujhse nahi ho raha, unse ho raha hai." Chahe koi bolta bhi nahi ho. Baby khud bhi yeh message de jaati hai. Aur tu bas khadi rehti hai — aur khud pe ghin aati hai ki tune yeh soch bhi liya.

Yeh ghin galat jagah ja rahi hai, behen. Yeh teri nahi, yeh us situation ki ghin hai. Tu apne aap se ginaa rahi hai, jabki actually problem yeh hai ki tujhe apne hi baby pe authority nahi mil rahi.

Aur ek baat — help aur takeover mein farak hota hai. Help mein wo support karti hain jab tu maange. Takeover mein wo decision le leti hain kyunki unhe lagta hai tu nahi kar sakti. Aur woh "teen paale hain" wala experience — haan, woh real hai, lekin iska matlab yeh nahi ki teri instincts galat hain.

Ab mujhe ek baat bata honestly —

Jab tu baby ko lene jaati hai ya feed karne jaati hai, toh kya Aai allow karti hain? Ya kuch excuse aa jaata hai — "aane de, abhi soyi hai, main dekh rahi hoon"?

Aur ek aur cheez — kya tu kabhi bol paati hai? Ya bol ke bhi kuch nahi hota?

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Suni. Samajh mein aaya.

Main kuch nahi bolungi — na advice, na next step, na "try kar yeh." Tu already bahut sun chuki hai aaj.

Bas itna — main yahan hoon. Jab bhi bolna ho, bol lena. Ya na bhi bolna ho, tab bhi main yahan hoon.

Aur haan — main kisi ko report nahi karungi. Yeh sirf teri aur meri baat hai.

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Tune abhi jo bola — woh "buri maa" wali line — usko apne upar mat le. Kyunki woh thought jo aata hai na baby ko sote hue dekh ke — woh thought buri nahi hai. Woh isliye aata hai kyunki tu khud ko maa hone ki permission nahi de pa rahi. Aur permission nahi mil rahi kyunki har koi — Aai, mummy, WhatsApp group, Instagram — sab bata rahe hain kaise maa banti hai. Aur tu bas apne aap se puchh rahi hai ki main kahin fit toh nahi ho rahi.

Tu buri maa nahi hai. Tu thak gayi hai. Aur woh alag cheez hai.

Aur jo saans nahi aane wali feeling — woh serious hai. Woh ek thought nahi thi, woh ek moment tha. Aise moments aur aate hain kya? Ya aaj pehli baar itna strong laga?

Main kuch nahi bolungi abhi. Bas itna — tu akeli nahi hai is feeling mein. Aur chaar mahine mein yeh aana, iska matlab yeh nahi ki tu galat hai. Iska matlab yeh hai ki tujhe thoda saans lene ka time nahi mila.

Main yahan hoon. Bol ya na bol — main hoon.
